title: Heave-Ho: Decentralized Long-Horizon Multi-Humanoid Collaboration
abstract: arXiv:2611.22275v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Collaboration promises to extend humanoid capabilities beyond what individual robots can achieve. However, realizing this potential requires coordinated whole-body interactions, coherent long-horizon planning, and precise synchronization across robots. We introduce Heave-Ho, a decentralized framework for long-horizon collaborative multi-humanoid loco-manipulation. At the low level, we develop a multi-agent post-training framework that adapts a humanoid foundation tracking model to physically coupled interactions between humanoids, enabling coordinated decentralized control from local observations alone. At the high level, we train a vision-language planner and design a speech-based leader-follower coordination mechanism to synchronize decentralized execution without network communication. Trained with two identical humanoids, our system scales to teams of up to ten robots and generalizes to heterogeneous teams without retraining. To be

translated_title: Heave-Ho：去中心化的长时程多人形机器人协作
translated_abstract: 协作有望将人形机器人的能力扩展到超越单个机器人所能达到的水平。然而，实现这一潜力需要协调的全身交互、连贯的长时程规划以及机器人之间的精确同步。我们提出了Heave-Ho，一个面向长时程协作式多人形机器人移动操作的去中心化框架。在低层，我们开发了一个多智能体后训练框架，将人形机器人基础追踪模型适配到人形机器人之间物理耦合的交互中，仅凭局部观测即可实现协调的去中心化控制。在高层，我们训练了一个视觉-语言规划器，并设计了一种基于语音的领导者-跟随者协调机制，从而在无需网络通信的情况下同步去中心化执行。我们的系统通过两台相同的人形机器人进行训练，可扩展至最多十台机器人的团队，并且无需重新训练即可泛化到异构团队。
tldr: 该论文提出Heave-Ho去中心化框架，通过多智能体后训练实现物理耦合的人形机器人协调控制，结合视觉-语言规划器与基于语音的领导者-跟随者机制，在无需网络通信的情况下实现最多十台（含异构）人形机器人的长时程协作移动操作。
en_tdlr: Heave-Ho is a decentralized framework for long-horizon collaborative multi-humanoid loco-manipulation that scales to teams of up to ten robots, combining multi-agent post-training for physically coupled whole-body control, a vision-language planner, and speech-based leader-follower coordination without network communication, while generalizing to heterogeneous teams without retraining.
